critical_code_review_comments: src/app/actions/customer-subscriptions.ts:120 periodStart falls back to today when template.periodStart AND template.lastRunAt are both null. Effect: change on day 1 of the derived period → ratio=1 → preview always shows 'remainingDays==totalDays' (e.g. 30/30) and unusedCredit==currentNet. The math is internally consistent, but a plan change on the SAME day the period is deemed to start effectively re-bills the full new price with zero real proration. Consider persisting periodStart when the template is first created / when advance() runs, so mid-period changes truly prorate. Not blocking.

src/app/actions/customer-subscriptions.ts:134-147 Downgrade emits a regular positive invoice with docType=invoice (via saveDraft/issueInvoice) whose *notes* say 'Αναλογική πίστωση' and whose line description says 'Αναλογική έκπτωση συνδρομής'. Semantically this INCREASES the customer's receivables (ΤΠΥ-0005 200,00€ net was added to Ανεξόφλητα) instead of crediting them. If the intent is a credit/πιστωτικό, this should issue a credit-note docType (or at minimum apply the amount as a payment/discount on future invoices). Currently satisfies the spec's 'credit/discount variant' only textually. HIGH.

src/app/actions/customer-subscriptions.ts:126 changePlan replaces the entire lines[] with a single line derived from lines[0]; discards additional lines. If a subscription template has multiple lines (add-ons, discounts), they are silently lost after any plan change. MEDIUM.

src/lib/payments/subscriptions.ts:99 idempotencyKey `sub-charge-${invoice.id}-${round2(amount)}` uses round2 (returns number) → key becomes e.g. 'sub-charge-<id>-186'; multiple different chargings on the same invoice with the same rounded amount would collide, but partial-payment scenarios differing at the cent level would generate distinct keys — acceptable but consider .toFixed(2) for stability.

src/app/api/cron/recurring/route.ts:14 `export const POST = GET;` exposes the same handler on GET; safe because runDueTemplatesForAll is idempotent per-day, but any unauthenticated GET without Bearer is 401 (good).

sendSaveCardLinkAction always copies the URL client-side even when the customer email exists; the toast says 'στάλθηκε και email αν υπάρχει'. If the mailer silently fails (mailer catch → undefined), the user still gets the success toast. Consider surfacing 'email απέτυχε' as a warning.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 2/3 (Αυτόματες Συνδρομές) works end-to-end for the paths that don't require completing the Stripe hosted form. Off-session card charging path (chargeInvoiceOffSession success branch) was NOT exercised because no card is saved (Stripe hosted form intentionally not filled in headless). To exercise the full happy path: manually complete a Setup at the checkout.stripe.com URL from send-card-link with test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, wait for the Stripe webhook (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env), then hit POST /api/cron/recurring or press retry-charge-<templateId>. Two side-effects to be aware of before re-running: template amount is now 300 net (not 434), and template chargeFailCount=2. The 'Αναλογική έκπτωση/πίστωση' code path issues a regular positive invoice (see critical review point 2) — consider addressing before further testing.
